title: Organizational Apps
summary: Package reports, notebooks, real-time dashboards and other Fabric items into governed, audience-aware org apps, and manage their access, ALM and lifecycle.
audience: BI developers, Fabric and Power BI administrators, analytics architects

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: What org apps are, when to use them, status of the capabilities, prerequisites at a glance and a map of the playbook.

pages.title: Concepts and choosing an app model
pages.description: Anatomy of an org app, live references versus snapshots, how access propagates, and a decision table against workspace apps, embedding, template apps and Fabric Apps.

pages.title: Prerequisites and governance
pages.description: Tenant settings, workspace types and capacity, per-user licenses, workspace roles, the write-and-reshare rule and a pre-flight checklist.

pages.title: Build and customize an org app
pages.description: Audience-first design, step-by-step creation, content curation, navigation, overview page, branding, preview and save.

pages.title: Integrating Fabric and Power BI items
pages.description: Supported item types, what each grants to consumers, Direct Lake and Real-Time Dashboard identity models, and where access is not propagated.

pages.title: Access, ALM and lifecycle
pages.description: Sharing, audiences, revoking access, Git integration, deployment pipelines, updating and deleting an org app.

pages.title: Practices, pitfalls and roadmap
pages.description: Best practices, symptom-to-fix troubleshooting, consumer surfaces, how to track capability changes, and a final checklist.
